Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting house-to-house sales of books, periodicals, or newspapers to certain hours.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requirements for peddlers and vendors of books,periodicals, or newspapers; adding a new section to chapter 36.71 RCW;and providing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Peddlers and vendors of books, periodicals, or newspapers who sellhousetohouse may only sell or offer to sell goods between the hoursof 10:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. or thirty minutes after sunset, whicheveris earlier. A person who sells or offers to sell outside of thesetimes commits a class 2 civil infraction under chapter 7.80 RCW and issubject to a fine set out in chapter 7.80 RCW.
